located_point.method: Site index point, which matches the coordinate printed in Bhan and Ajithprasad's Shikarpur 2007-2008 report (23 deg 14' 15" N, 70 deg 40' 39" E, PDF page 9). On the composite the point lies south of the highway between a pond and a dense tree grove; the 116 m square fortification of the plan could not be outlined, so the mound was not located independently.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: no straight edge near the point could be tied to the mud-brick fortification; the straight features are the highway, field boundaries and the edges of a pond and a tree grove

notes: Plan only. The grey band is labelled 'Plan of fortification', a drawn reconstruction that includes the excavated parts of the mud-brick wall; its inner and outer edges were both measured, eight lines in all, and all lie within 0.8 degrees of the plan's north symbol. The symbol is a crosshair circle without an arrowhead, so its axis was measured as a 71-pixel line and its error dominates the line errors. The excavation grid lines drawn across the plan are parallel to the fortification.
